description.narrative: Dominica Planned Parenthood Association is an affiliate of Caribbean Family Planning. They are the leading provider and enabler of sexual and reproductive health services in Dominica and an advocate of sexual and reproductive rights, working closely with other civil society organizations and the government. They provide family planning information, education, and health services that otherwise wouldn't be accessible to vulnerable and marginalized populations, including contraceptive services, sex education, gynecology, obstetric and family health service, and counselling. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, organizational training and capacity strengthening, monitoring and evaluation-related costs, phone services, internet, utilities, office rent, office supplies, software, equipment, and others; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as facilitation fees, transportation, meals, materials, and others; - Operation of teen clinic, provision of sexual and reproductive health services, and LED screen advertising; - Assistance to youth both on and out of school with tuition fees, textbooks, and others.
